environment.description: ECS Fargate task running in a public subnet with an internet gateway. The task role has s3:PutObject on s3:* (all buckets). No VPC endpoint configured - S3 traffic routes over the internet. The container runs with default seccomp profile. Actix-web payload limit is set to 10MB, well above the 4096-byte staging buffer.

config.network: Public subnet with IGW, no VPC endpoint for S3
config.s3_access: Direct internet path to S3 API
